profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer Sr. at Lockheed Martin Aeronautics
profile.summary:
Interested in application of Lean principles in software engineering and model based design.

Specialties: Model Based Design, MATLAB, Simulink, Java, C/C++, RTW, XML, LDRA, UML, SysML, Objective-C, iPhone application development,
Lean/Six Sigma Green Belt Certification

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer Sr.
positions.description:
•	Supported first flight of all three variants of F-35 aircraft 
•	Certified Lean/Six Sigma Green Belt facilitating software process improvement using Apollo Root Cause Analysis 
•	Worked directly with The Mathworks to develop MATLAB, Simulink, SystemTest, PolySpace, and Design Verifier products
•	Scripted Model Advisor checks to automatically verify 80% of all modeling standards *SPOT Award 03/08*
•	Developed  and tested embedded software for Joint Strike Fighter Hydraulics and Utilities Actuation Software Team
•	Responsible for 100% assembly language unit tests using LDRA for HUA and Fire Protection Systems *SPOT Award 12/06*
•	Created new methods and processes for JSF HUA team achieving 99% automatically generated code and unit tests
•	Analyzed, designed, and implemented new features for Signal Interface Management System (SIMS) including a CORBA API
•	Architect and team lead for a scalable, modular, and complete automated testing application for SIMS using WinRunner
•	Responsible for development of Generalized Exchange of Methods and Data (GEMD) *SRA Special Recognition Award 12/02*
•	Utilized Java, Swing, CORBA, XML, VC++, C, UML, OOAD, flex/bison, wxWindows, WinRunner, MATLAB, Simulink, RTW
•	Created coding and modeling standards for team and performed all roles in various Software Product Evaluation (SPE) sessions

positions.title: Contracted Consultant
positions.description:
Clients: Odetics Broadcast, Eagle Traffic Control Systems, AIM Technologies, Insurance Resources 
•	Used COM and OLE DB to create a Visual C++ interface to the SQL Server database
•	Ported database from DB4 flat file format to normalized relational SQL database reducing lines of code and improving performance
•	Developed VC++ COM SQL Database Code to interface with a large WinNT Traffic Control system
•	Created VC++ tool to bypass system and test databases individually
•	Designed several Lotus Notes Databases to assist in project management

positions.title: I/T Specialist - Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Team lead responsible for development of Lotus Notes ID registration/administration agent (DAAT)
•	Migrated large code base from C++ on AIX to object oriented VC++ on Windows NT *Special Achievement Award 05/99*
•	Defined Software Development procedures for team (source control, design and code reviews)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: •	Used object-oriented Visual C++, SQL, and the Lotus Notes API to apply database design for Notes and Domino

positions.title: World Wide Web Administrator - Athletic Department
positions.description: •	Led, trained and coordinated 30 member team in design and maintenance of large, frequently updated web project

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: •	Programmed tests in Java for newly developed microprocessor and worked with team members to create C++ test programs for ISDN

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: •	Used CA-Clipper 5.2 to design custom database programs for clients and established and maintained corporate website

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: •	Designed and programmed testing methods and utilities for software and Implemented efficient error reporting system
